spec.prompt_text: The maintenance record lists robot sensors, inspection dates and replacement parts.
spec.hypothesis: For pinned Qwen Q8 single-token decode, concatenate existing packed Q/K/V rows and quantization metadata without requantization, reducing three quantized_matmul API nodes to one. Compare raw native and compiled-three strong controls. No custom low-bit kernel or new Attention architecture.
spec.correctness: Require exact bitwise equality of all Q/K/V outputs for all 24 layers at each prompt first decode, and every returned full-vocabulary last-position logit plus every final visible K/V and token for the fixed 17-forward model path. Profile synchronized adapter must match baseline. Save failing arrays before stopping all performance trials. No tolerance adjustment.
spec.profile: One warmup per native and profile path per prompt, then one recorded native reference and one synchronized per-stage instrumented path per prompt, 16 decode forwards x24 layers x8 stages. Each stage mx.eval includes host dispatch+GPU completion. Capture copies lie between stages. Report QKV fraction of instrumented stage sum only; never actual uninstrumented attribution or Amdahl bound. Proceed to candidate only if p4096 QKV fraction >=0.10. Full profile outputs must match baseline bitwise.
spec.timing: Fixed custom synchronous greedy model loop: one whole prompt forward then 16 single-token decode forwards, 17 returned greedy tokens incl initial; no EOS early exit, prefetch, queue or continuous batching. All arms use unchanged full-sequence native prefill. Total includes cache construction, adapter install/restore, argmax item sync and final sync; excludes load/tokenization/packing/compilation/audit NumPy copies/destruction. TTFT includes first forward; decode_ms is sum of16 subsequent model+argmax steps. Projection micro samples each execute 24 captured real layer inputs once, mx.async_eval then final sync; not isolated kernel timing or request p95.
spec.memory: Report packed tensor bytes, one-off construction wall time, active allocation immediately before/after packing, per-timed-request MLX peak with prepared candidate resident in every arm. Native profile-phase receipts before packing are correctness-phase observations only, not a matched performance memory control. Packed storage is added overhead, not a memory saving. MLX peak excludes NumPy archive copies and process RSS.
spec.order: One experiment, fixed RNG arm permutations in each round/repeat, every record retained. Warmups excluded. Compilation warmed outside timing. No alternative candidate or parameter search.
spec.provenance: Protocol+implementation+verifier committed before first GPU/model execution; source snapshots and hashes bind private results. All real arrays stay local; public scalars and raw timing rows are independently recomputable but are not full numerical replay.
spec.limits: Mac only; upstream MLX quantized kernels; AI-assisted implementation not independent owner mastery; no new quality evaluation, CUDA/Ascend or phone deployment.
